statements.status_notes: The DHI docker-ce package builds the signed docker-v29.6.2 tag at Moby commit 3d80467678f6e36325fa9ae3dd486fe91e5652e3, then updates Go dependencies before compilation, which causes Go build metadata to report this dirty pseudo-version. Docker Engine release notes document the CVE-2026-42306 fix in 29.5.1, so it is present in 29.6.2.
